learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to read calendars, understand weeks and months, and track time!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A calendar tells us the day, week, and month. It helps us know when our fun holidays begin and when we are going to visit Nani Maa!
If we leave on Monday and travel for 3 days, what day do we reach? We can count forward on the calendar to find out.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Holiday Planner
fun_activity.instructions: Take a real calendar and circle your birthday, your friends' birthdays, and your next school holiday with a bright marker!

quick_recap: ⭐ There are 7 days in a week and 12 months in a year.
⭐ We can use a calendar to count how many days are left for something exciting!
